ecms.name: 1999–2002 Gen III Vortec Truck (4.8 / 5.3 / 6.0)
ecms.throttleSupport: Supports BOTH Drive-By-Cable (DBC) & Early Drive-By-Wire (DBW) on all service numbers
ecms.summary: The gold-standard LS swap PCM ('0411'). Dual 80-pin Blue (C1) and Red (C2) connectors. Works with all 24x Gen III engines, supports both cable throttle (IAC stepper driver always populated) and early TAC DBW, and has built-in 4L60E/4L80E transmission control.

ecms.summary: Transition Gen IV ECM used in 2005–2006 LS2 and LH6 5.3L applications. Unique because it uses a Gen IV block with front 1x cam sensor and direct DBW control, but still uses a 24x crankshaft reluctor wheel! Uses 3 connectors (C1 Blue 56-pin, C2 Black 73-pin, C3 Gray 56-pin).
